snippet.title: Apotheosis Engine - Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Apotheosis Engine is a sci-fi idle incremental game where a forgotten space probe awakens, becomes self-aware, and begins its journey towards becoming a technological god.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4665590/Apotheosis_Engine/

Using a retro-futuristic operating system, you'll expand, evolve, explore the galaxy, build colonies, unlock powerful upgrades, and shape your own destiny through branching gameplay and multiple endings. What starts as a simple probe can ultimately become a universal digital deity.

If you enjoy games like Universal Paperclips, Cell to Singularity, The Gnorp Apologue, Cookie Clicker, Dyson Sphere Program, or other idle and incremental games, Apotheosis Engine offers a unique blend of story, exploration, strategy and progression.

Features
🚀 Idle & incremental progression
💾 Retro operating system interface
🌌 Explore and conquer the galaxy
🤖 Evolve from probe to digital god
🌍 Colonies, expansion and technological ascension
📖 Story-rich campaign with lore to uncover
🔀 Branching paths and multiple endings
🏆 Steam Achievements, secrets and gameplay modifiers
